definitions.full: H273. Achzay אַחְזַי אֲחַזְיָה, אֲחַזְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( Yah(u) hath grasped ; ᵐ5 Ὀχοζ ( ε ) ιας 1Kin 22:52 etc., compare Lag BN 53 ) **compare Arabic VIII, + = adopt , hence perhaps ׳י hath adopted . 1 king of Israel, son of Ahab 1Kin 22:40 , 50 , 52 ; 2Kin 1:18 ; 2Chr 20:37 ( אֲחַזְיָהוּ ); + 2Kin 1:2 ; 2Chr 20:35 ( אֲחַזְיָה ). 2 king of Judah, son of Joram 2Kin 8:24-25 , 9:21 ; 10:13 ; 11:1 ; 12:19 ; 13:1 ; 14:13 ; 1Chr 3:11 ; 22:1 15 t. 2Kings, 1Chronicles (all אֲחַזְיָהוּ ); 2Kin 9:16 , 23 , 27 , 29 ; 11:2 ( אֲחַזְיָה ). 3 אַחְזַי a priest Neh 11:13 (for which יַחְזֵרָה 1Chr 9:12 see Sm Listen, Tafel ).
